name: Silhouette Edge Detection (Polygonal)
aliases: Image-based silhouette rendering of polygonal isosurfaces
definition: For a polygonal model, the silhouette edge set is defined as the set of all edges shared by both a front and back facing polygon, where the change of sign in the dot product indicates a silhouette edge.
summary: Silhouette Edge Detection (Polygonal) identifies object boundaries in non-photorealistic rendering by highlighting edges between front- and back-facing polygons using z-buffer tests, distinguishing it from continuous surface methods.
